Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Technology is advancing with a startling pace, and some people have trouble keeping up with the most modern aspects. A recent interview with a retiree and a teenager aimed to get at just this issue. Only one of the two had difficulties, though. The retiree found that they actually enjoyed adapting to the newest gadget, and it was only the teenager who found the whole processing too exhausting, and kind of gave up completely already. Who is out of touch with modern times?
A. Not known
B. The teenager
C. The retiree
